title: 高松宮記念の後に・あなたの背は

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King is victorious in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. Despite facing heavy criticism for destroying the dreams of the next generation, she boldly asserts that this is the path she's chosen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Through her actions and words, King shows me how to take pride in being myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I must stop being afraid of hurting others and behave in a way that's true to myself! I decide to participate in the talk show at the Fan Fest as a way to show my conviction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's scary, of course, but I have someone by my side who reassures me that I'm not alone!
